objectives: 培養學生具備電子電路基礎觀念，以為後續進階課程建立紮實基礎。
content:
Ch1：Semiconductor & Diode
p-type semiconductor
    n-type semiconductor

	Device structure & operation
	MOS Amplifiers

	Ideal op-amp
	Non-ideal (physical) op-amp
